title: Path matching and its DNF term
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let a path assign either no value or a value in $\bbr/2\bbr$ to each coordinate, and let $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$. The DNF term associated with the path evaluates to $-1$ at $x$ if and only if the binary vector corresponding to $x$ agrees with every value assigned by the path.
hypotheses_covered: A path whose terminal label lies in the sign set $\{−1,1\}$
